events.title: Shibuya Scramble Crossing
events.description: Start with the classic crossing, then coffee near Center Gai.

events.title: Meiji Jingu and Yoyogi Park
events.description: Walk through the shrine grounds and take the park loop.

events.title: Harajuku lunch
events.description: Try a beef bowl, ramen, or crepe on Takeshita Street.

events.title: Omotesando and Cat Street
events.description: Boutiques, design stores, and a slower walk back toward Shibuya.

events.title: Shibuya dinner
events.description: Choose sushi, izakaya, or a rooftop view for the evening.

events.title: Senso-ji and Nakamise Street
events.description: Go early to avoid the biggest crowds and shop for snacks.

events.title: Asakusa coffee break
events.description: Pause in a kissaten before crossing toward Ueno.

events.title: Ueno Park and museum stop
events.description: Pick one museum or keep it light with a park walk.

events.title: Akihabara arcades and shops
events.description: Spend the afternoon on games, figures, and electronics.

events.title: Ramen or curry dinner
events.description: Best after a long walking day and a late arcade session.

events.title: Tsukiji Outer Market breakfast
events.description: Seafood rice bowls, tamagoyaki, and fresh fruit.

events.title: Ginza shopping streets
events.description: Walk Chuo-dori, browse depachika, and grab lunch nearby.

events.title: Odaiba waterfront
events.description: Ride out for the bay views, then visit the seaside park.

events.title: Sunset at the bay
events.description: Stay for skyline photos, then head back for a final dinner.

components.text:
- Use JR Yamanote for Shibuya, Harajuku, Ueno, and Akihabara connections.
- Metro is fastest for Asakusa, Tsukiji, Ginza, and Odaiba transfers.
- Start early on Day 2 and Day 3 to beat crowds and get the best food selections.
- Good food picks: ramen in Shibuya, crepes in Harajuku, sushi at Tsukiji, tonkatsu in Ginza, and tempura or curry around Ueno.
- Keep one IC card loaded for taps across trains, subways, and many vending machines. Illustrative data
